issues.where: lower-right and upper-right planet limb (tiles C, E, F, G, I; also image-01.png, image-03.png tiles K, L, R, and image-04.png tile W)
issues.what: the atmosphere forms a detached bright cyan shell line separated from the globe by a dark trough, creating a stark doubled edge round the limb
issues.fix: integrate volumetric atmospheric scattering continuously from the globe surface outward with a smooth radial density falloff instead of an offset rim shell

issues.where: ring system across tiles A, C, D, F (also image-05.png, image-07.png tiles M, O, R, and image-08.png tile S)
issues.what: the rings are filled with blurry, clumpy cellular noise blobs stretched along the arcs rather than fine concentric icy ringlets and dust bands
issues.fix: replace the coarse 2D blotchy noise map on the ring plane with high-frequency radial ringlet profiles and fine subpixel particle grain

issues.where: center-right edge of the solar core in tile M (also image-01.png upper right sun)
issues.what: a dark crescent-shaped pit sits directly inside the bright white disk of the sun
issues.fix: fix shader clamping or remove the occluding artifact in the sun core so luminance peaks smoothly at the center

issues.where: atmospheric haze just above the top limb in tile F (also image-03.png tiles K and L)
issues.what: blotchy, frond-like noise patches protrude upward from the limb glow against the Milky Way backdrop
issues.fix: remove procedural noise modulation from the outer atmospheric glow so the limb haze fades cleanly into space

issues.where: upper-left sunlit planet limb in tiles B and I, and moon limb in tile G (also image-07.png tiles J, K and image-03.png tile J)
issues.what: visible 1-pixel stair-stepping and hard aliased cutout edges appear along the bright planet limb and moon silhouettes
issues.fix: increase supersampling/anti-aliasing on sphere silhouettes and add subtle atmospheric or micro-limb softening

issues.where: white cloud streaks and storm rim in tiles B and H (also image-07.png tile J and image-02.png tile A)
issues.what: bright cloud wisps and the storm collar show blocky, pixelated texels alongside diagonally smeared cloud texture
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution cloud map or procedural detail pass so cloud filaments stay crisp at native crop scale

issues.where: Milky Way dust bands in tiles B, C, F (also image-03.png tiles K, M)
issues.what: the background nebula texture looks soft and blocky with pixelated color noise next to crisp 1-pixel foreground stars
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution, denoised skybox plate matched to native output resolution

issues.where: planet shadow boundary across the upper-left rings in tile S (also image-05.png)
issues.what: the planet shadow cuts across the rings in a razor-hard curve with no penumbra
issues.fix: soften the planetary shadow edge on the rings slightly to account for finite solar angular size and ring scattering
